description: Turn an address into coordinates: BAN for France (INSEE code, score), OpenStreetMap elsewhere. Address to coordinates: for France the official BAN registry (house number, street, postcode, city, INSEE code, match score), elsewhere OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Query: ?q=8 rue de la Paix Paris&country=fr&limit=1 — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "coordinates of this address", "geocode this address", "latitude and longitude of a french address".
name: geo_forward
